search.method: CIELCh lightness only; hue and chroma held so class identity survives
constraints: no new high-contact ΔE00 failure (normal, deuteranopia, protanopia)
no new pair below the ΔL* floor
no regression under the deepest measured 2x shading

note: The palette is baked into the Blender render, so adopting a candidate is a re-render of the scientific map, not a layout change.
